policy: Describe contribution categories honestly. Do not assign unsupported percentages and do not infer human authorship merely because a human prompted an AI system.

formal_tracking_begins_with.note: Earlier development history is not retrospectively reconstructed into the formal ledger. Existing source, tests, releases, conversations, and public timestamps may independently document earlier work.

creator_originated_or_creator_directed: Game concept, goals, system direction, feature selection, balance direction, and acceptance or rejection of revisions when supported by contemporaneous project records.
Playtest interpretation and decisions about which problems to solve, what behavior is intended, and what constitutes an acceptable stable pass.
Creative selection, arrangement, integration, and revision decisions where specifically documented.
Creator-authored text or direct code edits only where separately identifiable or recorded.
ai_assisted: Implementation, refactoring, debugging, test generation, documentation drafting, and other development work may be AI-assisted unless a more specific record says otherwise.
Visual, audio, music, or text assets may include generated or AI-assisted material where identified by project records or submission disclosures.
third_party_or_external: Playtester feedback can influence design decisions but is not treated by this manifest as creator authorship.
Third-party libraries, tools, assets, and licenses retain their own authorship and license status where applicable.

important_limits: This manifest is a project record, not a legal certificate or a guarantee of copyrightability.
The provenance ledger records stated decisions and hashes. It does not independently prove that every narrative statement is true.
No entry should claim AI-generated implementation was handwritten by the creator unless there is a separate factual basis for that claim.
